title: Subinvariance plus polynomial killing gives polynomial attempt moments
statement: For sub-Markov Q with mu Q<=mu and 1-Q1(y)>=c(1+a+|y|)^(-K),the source proves E_y L^r<=C_r(1+a+|y|)^(2Kr) for every integer r>=1. L counts successive attempts up to failure. Constants are uniform in a,y under the stated Poisson tail bounds.

requires: Finite full-support mu with point lower bound exp[-C(1+m)log(2+m)] and upper tail C exp[-cR log(2+R)];fixed positive c,K and uniform tail constants.
provides: For sub-Markov Q with mu Q<=mu and 1-Q1(y)>=c(1+a+|y|)^(-K),the source proves E_y L^r<=C_r(1+a+|y|)^(2Kr) for every integer r>=1. L counts successive attempts up to failure. Constants are uniform in a,y under the stated Poisson tail bounds.

costs: No spectral gap,mixing,stationary entrance or repeated Lp loss. Constants/exponent may be poor.
